description: Identity card for one insider by CIK (SEC's numeric filer identifier): name, all known titles, and director/officer/10%-owner role flags. Returns NO transactions — when the user asks what an insider bought, sold or filed, use get_insider_transactions (raw rows) or get_insider_career_summary (aggregated rollup) instead. If you only have a name, resolve it to a CIK first with search. Free plan.

cik.description: Insider CIK number — SEC's numeric filer identifier, e.g. 0001214128. Leading zeros optional. Resolve a name to a CIK first with search_insiders if you don't already have it.

name: get_insider_profile
